claim: Dew uses actual night density; frozen geometry, thermal and gas conventions are explicitly separated.
source_report_body: Equation-only clarification filed in CONVENTIONS.md; no executable code is attached. Each dry compartment contains one Be face plus half the core metal; coating/polymer storage is omitted. Outer enthalpy is referenced to ice at 273.15 K, with incoming vapor enthalpy Ls+cpv(Ta−273.15), added once. Lewis transfer and ambient density use 95460.83791390515 Pa throughout. Through-core conductance is 130*rho_core/(2700*tc)+0.8*sigmaSB*mean(Tinner)^3, with the area-weighted old inner temperature. Night geometries are the mask11, usage1 MASS-CURVES reference rows. All fluxes use the old state in forward Euler; phase is decoded from updated enthalpy and mass for output. The attached equations include constants, geometry, saturation, convection and update order. Original results and qualifications are unchanged.
numerical_scope: Synthesis of attributed reports; consult named check/review findings for numerical disposition
qualification: Available weather points are not operational availability. The later 058 day fractions omit exclusions and do not prove a feasible continuous history with admitted air, ballast and ground recovery.
